summary.reason: plugin-level packages (raster-js, puzzle-js, energy-js) publish artifact/extension files through glue files that live under the plugin package dir; the glue imports the artifact, so the plugin owner depends on its artifact. Fix = artifact-level packages (the stdio/puzzle-2d pattern) so the glue lives under the artifact owner. Needs a workspace entry in ✏️s/package.json and a bun.lock refresh, both frozen.

newPackages.name: @semio-tech/raster-js
newPackages.action: move the package from the plugin package dir to the artifact package dir (name and exports subpaths unchanged, so the importer needs no edit)

newPackages.name: @semio-tech/puzzle-5d
newPackages.action: new artifact-level package for the 5d artifact; drop the 5d glue and its export from @semio-tech/puzzle-js

removals.reason: re-exports runWeatherChecks from the epw extension tests; no importer exists in the repository (git grep), and the plugin owner must not depend on its extension

coveredElsewhere.note: the 9 no-cross-package-relative edges from ✏️s/🧑‍💻dev/🧩️puzzle/📖️stories/{2d-fixtures,3d-world,5d-timeline} to the example .dsl.semio assets need the puzzle-2d, puzzle-3d-ts/rs and puzzle-js (5d, becomes puzzle-5d after the package above) example subpaths recorded there. The 5d stories import 3 assets; after @semio-tech/puzzle-5d exists, the 5d example exports belong to that package instead of puzzle-js.
